t: Readiness Estimator: Air Quality Refuge Systems
title: Readiness Estimator: Air Quality Refuge Systems
definition: Estimates Air Quality Refuge Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Air Quality Refuge Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

t: Air Quality Refuge Systems Simulator
title: Air Quality Refuge Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Air Quality Refuge Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Air Quality Refuge Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 84167 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where filtration rooms monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or mask stocks maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Air Quality Refuge Systems Master Roadmap
title: Air Quality Refuge Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Air Quality Refuge Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Air Quality Refuge Systems — refuges with clean air during smoke events.

Phase 1 — Prove (filtration rooms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (mask stocks): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (alert integration): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
